meta.name: planning-with-files
meta.description: Persistent file-based planning for multi-step AI-agent work. Keeps task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md on disk; lifecycle hooks inject selected project planning context. Automatic recovery reads project planning files only. Explicit session-catchup.py --metadata reads same-project local agent session records and emits aggregate counts only; --replay may emit bounded nonce-framed excerpts. Optional gated mode can request continuation only when the host supports it and never runs commands declared in Markdown. The skill has no network upload path. Use for research or work needing 5+ tool calls.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把多步骤任务的计划、发现和进度存到磁盘,随时接着做
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果任务要跑很多步、担心中途丢失上下文和进度
copy.tagline_en: Keep a multi-step task's plan, findings, and progress on disk to resume later
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your task spans many steps and you fear losing context midway

howto.what: Claude 会把计划、发现和进度写进项目里的三个 markdown 文件(task_plan.md、findings.md、progress.md),每完成一个阶段就更新;即使上下文丢失或 /clear 过,也能从文件恢复接着做。
howto.when: 当你要求规划、拆解或整理多步骤项目、研究任务,或任务预计需要 5 次以上工具调用时触发;也支持 /clear 之后的自动会话恢复。

howto.what_en: Claude keeps a task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md in your project directory, writing plans, findings, and progress to disk and updating them after each phase, so work survives context loss or /clear.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask it to plan, break down, or organize a multi-step project, research task, or any work needing 5+ tool calls; it also supports automatic session recovery after /clear.
